name: Stereocilia Orientation Distribution Analysis
description:
Perform a directional analysis on the 'Organ of Corti' sample image to quantify the orientation of stereocilia bundles.

1. Open the sample image: File > Open Samples > Organ of Corti (58K).
2. If necessary, convert the image to 8-bit grayscale.
3. Use an orientation analysis tool (like Analyze > Directionality) to measure the angular distribution of structures.
4. Generate a histogram of orientations with at least 10 angular bins spanning a range of at least 150 degrees.
5. Determine the 'Preferred Direction' (peak angle) and 'Dispersion' (spread) of the structures.
6. Save a CSV file to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/directionality_results.csv' that contains:
   - The orientation histogram data (Direction/Angle vs Amount/Frequency)
   - The summary statistics (Preferred Direction and Dispersion)

Ensure the CSV is formatted clearly so both the histogram data and summary stats are readable.
